title: Some new results for Andrews' Kimberling partitions
summary: George E. Andrews (2016) introduced the Kimberling index, $K(π)$, of a partition $π$ of a positive integer $n$, which is defined as $$K(π) = (\text{largest part of } π) - (\text{least part of } π) - (\text{number of parts of } π).$$ Based on Kimberling index, Andrews defined five partition functions, $K_>(n),$ $K_ 0$, $ (n)$ and established some relations connecting Kimberling partitions and other partition functions.
